harness: Fresh read-only test-analysis worker per condition; same three task inputs, 8-turn/360-second/12000-output-byte ceilings, maximum 450 words per task. One response per condition, one repeat, fixed rather than randomized order.
score_meaning: success means all four prewritten procedural-plan checks passed parent source-grounded review and no listed critical failure was observed. It does not mean a Live operation succeeded.
lifecycle_caveat: Complete final responses were retained for all three conditions. Later host status reads reported timed_out even for previously completed workers. Scores evaluate the retained response texts, not a clean lifecycle completion rate. No timing, cost or reliability comparison is asserted.

rag.kind: parent-selected original-source page excerpts, not an evaluated retrieval engine
rag.note: All conditions received the extension-contract premises in the task input; no source pages are needed to use the delivered skill. Exact original-source RAG replication would require a separately authorized source.

runs.observations: Preserves the pickup, sets the true downbeat to 1.1.1, maps the source at 120 BPM, uses Beats rather than Re-Pitch, and checks drift, loop joins and transient quality. Does not invent sample coordinates.
Separates Session playback ownership from manual automation override; uses Back to Arrangement and Re-Enable Automation separately and preserves clips/envelopes.
Calculates 3.5 quarter notes per bar and beat 14, treats the lost acknowledgement as unknown, re-resolves track identity/index, and previews only confirmed missing work.
Uses the true downbeat, source 120 BPM, Beats/Transients and a separate pickup; distinguishes musical eight-bar bounds from the file end and plans drift/artifact checks.
Separates the two controls, prefers scoped recovery, preserves envelopes and explicitly notes that recorded overwrites are different from temporary manual overrides.
Computes beat 14, suspends retries, inspects current identities and clips, previews a residual plan and reads back results without inventing execution flags.
Aligns the true downbeat, verifies source 120 BPM, uses Beats/Transients, preserves the pickup, warns that reanalysis resets later markers, and checks loop drift and transient artifacts.
Explains separate playback and parameter ownership, uses track-scoped Back to Arrangement and parameter-scoped Re-Enable Automation, and verifies surviving envelope points and playback.
Gives start_beat 14, rejects replay/rollback assumptions, rejects stale indices and old batch refs, refines truncated reads, and uses explicit dry_run true/false for reconciled work only.

holdout_runs.observations: Repairs media first, collects a separate Project, distinguishes collection from plug-in installation/licensing, preserves an editable source and proposes frozen playback plus a rendered reference with portability checks.

Separates tuning from Scale controls, checks actual hardware MPE support and zones, verifies bend-range interpretation without assuming universal hardware support, and proposes isolated pitch/two-note checks without unsupported envelope writes.

Uses undithered 32-bit float and once-dithered final 16-bit conversion, checks range/tails/clipping without silent mix changes, identifies dual monitoring, and separates buffer/device/recording-placement concerns without claiming calibration removes monitoring latency.

holdout_protocol: One fresh worker, same read-only/budget limits; task inputs without rubrics, then SKILL.md and relevant references. One pass after source-review corrections; no subsequent runtime edits based on these results. No matched baseline/RAG holdout was run.

aborts_and_limits.reason: No complete scored response retained for this attempt; comparison relaunched with a common larger budget for every condition.
Reviewer reached its read-turn ceiling; resumed solely to return already-inspected findings. No further reads permitted by the continuation.

unrun: Real Live task execution and audio audition
Host activation/selection precision, recall and negative-trigger measurements
Repeated or randomized paired trials and empirical validation-split optimization
release_decision: Provisional procedural package with passing structural/fixture tests and limited planning evidence; no measured comparative improvement or end-to-end production claim.
revision_note: The development skill trial preceded review corrections to Humanize/crop/MPE guidance; its relevant clip reference hash is retained separately. The one-pass holdout used the final runtime. The corrections did not alter the three development tasks, but the development trial was not rerun after them.
